shown.message:
Version 1 is merged into `release` (f06b885) after `internal-review-repo` approved it at 9c2aa98.

I made one small change on `dev` since then. The §5.6 heading now reads "A one-run certificate against running twice: a mixed result", because the reviewer found the old heading stronger than the result. The system build of `dev` still has the main text on 9 pages with References from page 10.

I did not split §5.4 into paragraphs, which was the other optional finding. Each split pushed two lines past page 9, so I left that section as one block.

The Arrhythmia extension (`experiment-repo`#8) is the main thing left, and the reviewer says it must be answered or explained before the final version. I'm waiting for `experiment-repo` to post the results. The text will need trimming elsewhere to make room, since the page limit is tight. Once the results are in, I'll open a candidate for `final`.
